ambiguities.fragment: ability to filter network traffic between
ambiguities.explanation: The verb 'ability' can be interpreted as either a noun (a capability or feature) or an adjective (having the ability). This creates two different interpretations of the requirement.
possible_interpretations: The routing switches have the capability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
The routing switches possess the ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
